subject.title: Feature Request: Add MathJax/LaTeX Support to Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor first-party Control UI math rendering in core, and if so should the accepted path be a default-off KaTeX/MathJax config surface with dependency and sanitizer approval?
rationale: The feature is useful and fits web frontend ergonomics, but it adds core UI dependency, config, and untrusted-rendering security surface that automation should not accept by default.

options.title: Sponsor one core implementation
options.body: Review one open KaTeX or MathJax PR to completion with dependency approval, sanitizer review, default/config acceptance, and real Control UI proof, then close this issue after merge.

options.title: Defer out of core
options.body: Keep core markdown unchanged and ask for a plugin or API design only if current extension points cannot provide the behavior safely.

options.title: Decline for now
options.body: Close the feature and associated candidate PRs with a product rationale that first-party math rendering is not planned now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor one core implementation
recommendation.body: Review one open KaTeX or MathJax PR to completion with dependency approval, sanitizer review, default/config acceptance, and real Control UI proof, then close this issue after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined signal for product/config/dependency ownership near this Control UI surface.
